import kotlin.math.*

fun main() {
    val (r, x, y, x1, y1) = readLine()!!.split(" ").map { it.toLong() }
    val dx = x1 - x
    val dy = y1 - y
    val dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    val steps = ceil(dist / (2 * r)).toInt()
    println(steps)
}

import java.util.*
import kotlin.math.*

fun main() {
    val sc = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val r = sc.nextInt()
    val x = sc.nextInt()
    val y = sc.nextInt()
    val x1 = sc.nextInt()
    val y1 = sc.nextInt()
    val dx = (x1 - x).toDouble()
    val dy = (y1 - y).toDouble()
    val dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    if (dist == 0.0) {
        println(0)
        return
    }
    val steps = ceil(dist / (2 * r)).toInt()
    println(steps)
}
